title: PUT /v1/subscriptions/{id} request
description: Store a version of an own further subscription record (expected_version 0 creates it, never primary; the primary record is written through PUT /v1/me/credentials/claude_subscription), sealed under the caller's CK, author the caller or the caller's own-identity agent (03-api.md section 4.8, ADR-090).

use.description: the plaintext mirror of the use sealed in the record (ADR-090 section 3): the hub lists the subscription to the devices serving these organizations (or, with pool, to platform devices); the runner acts on the sealed use only. Absent: the mirror stays as it is.
